description: Na₅LuH₄(C₂O₇)₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal P̅42₁c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.32 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.72 Å. Lu is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.29 Å) and four longer (2.33 Å) Lu-O bond lengths. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.27 Å) and two longer (1.32 Å) C-O bond lengths. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one Lu, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Lu, and one C atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂LuC tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent H atoms.
